reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified: validateDataColumnSidecar (gossip_validation.nim:586-716) lacks epoch-specific max_blobs_per_block validation. The verify_data_column_sidecar function (peerdas_helpers.nim:352-366) only checks kzg_commitments.len > 0 and array consistency, allowing sidecars with excessive commitments to pass. In contrast, validateBeaconBlockDeneb (line 383-388) and validateBlobSidecar (line 403) both validate against MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK. Per 01e requirement (01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json): 'kzg_commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the sidecar's epoch' with assertion 'forall sidecar: len(sidecar.kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block'. Attacker control confirmed: via P2P gossip (data_column_sidecar_subnet_id topic), attacker sends data column sidecar with kzg_commitments.len=100 when epoch limit is 6, causing ~16x memory consumption per sidecar. Attack is attacker-triggered (external P2P input directly controls commitment count). Resource exhaustion impact: ColumnQuarantine has memory/disk limits (maxMemSidecarsCount, maxDiskSidecarsCount) but oversized sidecars consume proportionally more memory, accelerating DoS. Severity downgrade: Nimbus represents ~2-5% of Ethereum validators. Per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE severity_classification, impact >0.01% but <5% = Low severity. Original HIGH severity exceeds Nimbus single-client cap.
